---
pagetitle: "Climate resilience and equity profile of VCH communities"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(knitr)
library(htmltools)

da   <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "vch_da_index.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)
chsa <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "vch_chsa_summary.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)
val  <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "index_validation.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

f0 <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",")

# Headline numbers
da_tbl       <- st_drop_geometry(da)
n_da         <- sum(da_tbl$in_index)
n_chsa       <- sum(!is.na(chsa$svi_mean))
n_priority   <- sum(da_tbl$priority)
pop_priority <- sum(da_tbl$pop_total[da_tbl$priority], na.rm = TRUE)
rho_cisv     <- val$spearman_rho[grepl("CISV", val$comparison)]

veg_q <- da_tbl |>
  filter(in_index, !is.na(fvc_pct), !is.na(pop_total)) |>
  group_by(svi_quintile) |>
  summarise(fvc = weighted.mean(fvc_pct, pop_total), .groups = "drop")
veg_q1 <- veg_q$fvc[veg_q$svi_quintile == 1]
veg_q5 <- veg_q$fvc[veg_q$svi_quintile == 5]

# Banner stripes: neighbourhoods ordered by vulnerability (40 equal groups),
# each stripe coloured by the group's average vegetation cover
n_bins <- 40
stripe_df <- da_tbl |>
  filter(in_index, !is.na(fvc_pct)) |>
  mutate(bin = ntile(svi_score, n_bins)) |>
  group_by(bin) |>
  summarise(fvc = mean(fvc_pct), .groups = "drop")

pal_stripe <- colorNumeric(c("#d9c7a1", "#a8d5a2", "#1a7f4b"), domain = range(stripe_df$fvc))
w <- 1000 / n_bins
stripe_rects <- sprintf(
  '<rect x="%.2f" y="0" width="%.2f" height="26" fill="%s"><title>Vulnerability percentile %.0f to %.0f: %.0f%% vegetation cover</title></rect>',
  (stripe_df$bin - 1) * w, w + 0.6, pal_stripe(stripe_df$fvc),
  (stripe_df$bin - 1) * 100 / n_bins, stripe_df$bin * 100 / n_bins, stripe_df$fvc
)
stripes_svg <- HTML(paste0(
  '<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 26" preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img" ',
  'aria-label="Stripes showing vegetation cover falling as neighbourhood vulnerability rises">',
  paste(stripe_rects, collapse = ""), "</svg>"
))
```

```{r}
#| label: hero
#| column: screen
wave <- HTML('<svg class="hero-wave" viewBox="0 0 1440 80" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0,40 C240,80 480,0 720,30 C960,60 1200,10 1440,40 L1440,80 L0,80 Z"></path></svg>')

div(class = "hero-full",
  div(class = "hero-bg", stripes_svg),
  div(class = "hero-inner",
    div(class = "eyebrow", "Independent portfolio project · open data"),
    h1(class = "hero-title",
       "Who is most vulnerable to heat and smoke?", " ",
       span(class = "accent", "And where is green cover lowest?")),
    p(class = "hero-lede", sprintf(
      "A transparent social vulnerability index for %s neighbourhoods in the Vancouver Coastal Health region, mapped alongside vegetation cover. In the large urban area, vegetation covers %.0f%% of land in the most vulnerable fifth of neighbourhoods, compared with %.0f%% in the least vulnerable fifth.",
      f0(n_da), veg_q5, veg_q1)),
    div(class = "hero-buttons",
      a(class = "btn btn-accent", href = "#interactive-map", "Explore the map"),
      a(class = "btn btn-ghost", href = "briefing.html", "Read the briefing"),
      a(class = "btn btn-ghost", href = "https://github.com/emmabranch/vch-climate-equity-profile", "View the code")),
    p(class = "hero-note", "Background: each stripe is a group of urban neighbourhoods, ordered from least vulnerable (left) to most vulnerable (right) and coloured by average vegetation cover: tan is less, green is more."),
    p(class = "hero-note", "Not affiliated with or endorsed by Vancouver Coastal Health.")),
  wave)
```

```{r}
#| label: stats
stat <- function(num, lab) div(class = "stat-box", div(class = "num", num), div(class = "lab", lab))

div(class = "stat-row lift",
  stat(f0(n_da), "neighbourhoods scored (census dissemination areas)"),
  stat(n_priority, sprintf("priority neighbourhoods, home to about %s people", f0(pop_priority))),
  stat(tagList(sprintf("%.0f%%", veg_q5), span(class = "vs", " vs "), sprintf("%.0f%%", veg_q1)),
       "vegetation cover in the large urban area, most vs least vulnerable fifth"),
  stat(sprintf("%.2f", rho_cisv), "agreement with Statistics Canada's vulnerability index")
)
```

## How to read the map

- **Social vulnerability** combines five 2021 Census indicators with equal weights: people aged 65 and over, one-person households, low income, renter households, and people with no knowledge of English or French. Neighbourhoods are grouped into fifths across the VCH region, from 1 (least vulnerable) to 5 (most vulnerable).
- **Vegetation cover** is the share of ground covered by trees, shrubs, or grass, averaged over 2019 to 2024 (Statistics Canada). It is only available for the large urban area, so rural communities appear grey.
- **Priority areas** (dark blue outline) are in the most vulnerable fifth *and* the lowest third for vegetation cover.
- Use the layer box (top right of the map) to switch between vulnerability and vegetation, and to show or hide priority areas and CHSA boundaries. Click any neighbourhood for its details.

## Interactive map {#interactive-map}

```{r}
#| label: map
#| column: page

fmt <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

da <- da |>
  mutate(popup = paste0(
    "<strong>", chsa_name, "</strong><br>",
    "Dissemination area ", DAUID, ", population ",
    format(pop_total, big.mark = ","), "<br><br>",
    "<strong>Vulnerability quintile: ",
    ifelse(is.na(svi_quintile), "not scored", svi_quintile),
    "</strong> (score ", fmt(svi_score, 2), ")<br>",
    "Aged 65 and over: ", fmt(pct_65plus), "%<br>",
    "One-person households: ", fmt(pct_alone), "%<br>",
    "Low income (LIM-AT): ", fmt(pct_lowinc), "%<br>",
    "Renter households: ", fmt(pct_renter), "%<br>",
    "No English or French: ", fmt(pct_nolang), "%<br><br>",
    "Vegetation cover: ", fmt(fvc_pct), "%<br>",
    "Statistics Canada CISV quintile (national): ",
    ifelse(is.na(cisv_quintile), "n/a", cisv_quintile),
    ifelse(priority, "<br><br><strong>Priority: high vulnerability and low vegetation</strong>", "")
  ))

pal_svi <- colorFactor("YlOrRd", domain = 1:5, na.color = "#d9d9d9")
pal_fvc <- colorBin("Greens", domain = c(0, 100),
                    bins = c(0, 15, 25, 35, 50, 100), na.color = "#d9d9d9")

leaflet(width = "100%", height = "680px") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = da, group = "Social vulnerability",
    fillColor = ~pal_svi(svi_quintile), fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white", weight = 0.3, popup = ~popup,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333333", bringToFront = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = da, group = "Vegetation cover",
    fillColor = ~pal_fvc(fvc_pct), fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white", weight = 0.3, popup = ~popup,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333333", bringToFront = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = filter(da, priority), group = "Priority areas",
    fill = FALSE, color = "#08306b", weight = 2.5,
    options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = chsa, group = "CHSA boundaries",
    fill = FALSE, color = "#252525", weight = 1.2, opacity = 0.8,
    options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_svi, values = 1:5, position = "bottomright",
    title = "Vulnerability<br>quintile (5 = highest)", opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_fvc, values = c(0, 100), position = "bottomleft",
    title = "Vegetation<br>cover (%)", opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups    = c("Social vulnerability", "Vegetation cover"),
    overlayGroups = c("Priority areas", "CHSA boundaries"),
    options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -123.12, lat = 49.25, zoom = 11)
```

## Communities with the highest social vulnerability

Community Health Service Areas (CHSAs) ranked by population-weighted mean vulnerability score.

```{r}
#| label: top-chsa-table
chsa |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  arrange(svi_rank) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  transmute(
    Rank = svi_rank,
    CHSA = chsa_name,
    Population = format(population, big.mark = ","),
    `Mean vulnerability score` = round(svi_mean, 2),
    `Population in most vulnerable fifth (%)` = round(pct_pop_svi_q5),
    `Vegetation cover (%)` = round(fvc_mean)
  ) |>
  kable(align = "llrrrr")
```

## About this project

::: {.disclaimer}
This is an independent portfolio project using open data. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Vancouver Coastal Health. Methods, data sources, licences, and limitations are documented in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/emmabranch/vch-climate-equity-profile).
:::

**Data:** Statistics Canada 2021 Census Profile and boundary files; Statistics Canada Canadian Index of Social Vulnerability and Canadian Index of Multiple Deprivation (2021); Statistics Canada vegetation cover in large urban areas (Table 38-10-0187-01); BC Ministry of Health Community Health Service Area boundaries (BC Data Catalogue). The recommendations in the briefing draw on Vancouver Coastal Health's CLEAR report (2025). Basemap: Esri World Light Gray Canvas (Esri, HERE, Garmin, © OpenStreetMap contributors).
